text.A: **Šī politika ir piemērojama neatkarīgi no tā, kur jūs atrodaties.** Mēs ievērojam Apvienotās Karalistes datu aizsardzības tiesību aktus, un, ja ir piemērojami arī tās valsts datu aizsardzības tiesību akti, kurā jūs dzīvojat, mēs ievērojam arī tos.
text.B: **Piezīmes par alerģijām un uzturu.** Mēs tās kopā ar jūsu pasūtījumu nododam busiņam un neizmantojam nekam citam. Mēs tās kopā ar jūsu vārdu un kontaktinformāciju dzēšam 12 mēnešus pēc pasūtījuma (skatiet 7. sadaļu).
text.C: **Starptautiska nosūtīšana.** Jūsu konta dati un pasūtījumu dati tiek glabāti un apstrādāti Apvienotajā Karalistē. Dažas darbības tiek veiktas ārpus tās: ēdienkaršu satura iegūšana un WhatsApp automātiskās atbildes, kurās tiek izmantots Google pakalpojums Amerikas Savienotajās Valstīs; WhatsApp ziņojumu piegāde, ko veic Meta Amerikas Savienotajās Valstīs; maksājumi, ko apstrādā Stripe Amerikas Savienotajās Valstīs; un pašpiegādes paziņojumi, ko piegādā Apple un Google Amerikas Savienotajās Valstīs. Ja dati tiek nosūtīti ārpus Apvienotās Karalistes, nosūtīšanu aptver Apvienotās Karalistes noteikumi par aizsardzības līmeņa pietiekamību vai International Data Transfer Agreement (Starptautiskās datu nosūtīšanas līgums) vai Addendum (papildinājums), un, ja to prasa jūsu valsts tiesību akti, arī garantija, ko atzīst šie tiesību akti. Jūs varat lūgt mums sniegt informāciju par piemērojamajām garantijām.
text.G:
Mūsu [Pakalpojuma noteikumi](/terms) ir piemērojami katrā valstī, kur tiek izmantots HatchGrab. Dažās valstīs ir papildu noteikumi. Šajā lapā tie ir izklāstīti, katrai valstij atsevišķi.

Ja kāda no tālāk minētajām sadaļām attiecas uz jums, tā ir mūsu Pakalpojuma noteikumu daļa. Ja tajā ir noteikts kaut kas atšķirīgs no tiem, attiecīgajā valstī piemēro šo lapu.

Ja jūsu valsts nav minēta, papildu noteikumu nav: Pakalpojuma noteikumi ir piemērojami tā, kā tie ir uzrakstīti. Mūsu [Privātuma politika](/privacy) ir vienāda visās valstīs.

back.A: **This policy applies regardless of where you are.** We comply with UK data protection legislation, and if the data protection legislation of the country you live in also applies, we comply with that too.
back.B: **Notes about allergies and diet.** We pass them to the truck together with your order and use them for nothing else. We delete them together with your name and contact information 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: ...or Addendum (addendum), and, if the legislation of your country requires it, also a safeguard recognised by that legislation.
back.D: Intro: Under UK data protection legislation and, where it applies, the legislation of the country you live in, you have the right to: [bullets unchanged]. / The legislation of your country of residence may give you these rights under other names or give additional rights. You have those too. / **Making a request.** Write to privacy@hatchgrab.com. Before we act, we will check whether the request is genuine. You can ask someone else to submit the request in your place, and we will not treat you differently because you have made a request. We will reply within one month or sooner if the legislation of your country requires it. If you ordered from a truck, we may pass your request to that truck, because it determines how your order details are used. If we reject a request, you can ask us to review it by replying to our answer. / **Deleting your account.** [unchanged] + When an operator's account is deleted, we also delete its customers' names, contact information and notes from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only if the legislation of your country of residence allows it, and in some countries this means only with your consent. Each one states who it is from, includes our postal address and says how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we will do so free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a truck offer order updates by text message, you will receive them only if you agree, and you can cancel them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a breach affecting your personal data could cause you serious harm, we will, where the law requires it, notify you and the supervisory authority as soon as possible, or help the truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** First contact us by writing to privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would be grateful for the chance to put everything right. You can also lodge a complaint with the data protection supervisory authority of your country of residence. In the UK, that is the Information Commissioner's Office (Office of the Information Commissioner), website ico.org.uk, telephone 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Service] apply in every country where HatchGrab is used. Some countries have additional rules. This page sets them out, separately for each country. / If one of the sections below applies to you, it forms part of our Terms of Service. If it provides something different from them, this page applies in the country concerned. / If your country is not listed, there are no additional rules: the Terms of Service apply as written. Our [Privacy Policy] is the same in all countries.
